description.de: Erstellt Songs auf Suno aus vorhandenen Lyrics-Dateien via Chromium CDP-Session. Erwartet eine laufende Chromium-Instanz mit Remote-Debugging auf Port 9222 und ein vorbereitetes Suno-Login.
description.en: Creates songs on Suno from existing lyrics files via Chromium CDP session. Requires Chromium with remote-debugging on port 9222 and a logged-in Suno session.

config.command:
set -uo pipefail
echo '=== Suno Batch Pre-Check ==='
echo ''
BASE_DIR=$(eval echo '{{ base_dir }}')
SCRIPT_PATH="$BASE_DIR/{{ batch_script }}"
LYRICS_DIR="$BASE_DIR/{{ lang_pair }}/{{ collection }}"

echo '--- CDP Connection ---'
if curl -s --max-time 5 http://localhost:9222/json/version > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'CDP auf Port 9222: OK'
else
  echo 'FEHLER: CDP auf Port 9222 nicht erreichbar.'
  echo 'Starte Chromium mit:'
  echo '  chromium --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir=/tmp/suno-profile'
  exit 1
fi
echo ''

echo '--- Batch-Script ---'
if [ ! -f "$SCRIPT_PATH" ]; then
  echo "FEHLER: Batch-Script fehlt: $SCRIPT_PATH"
  echo "Setze defaultContext.batch_script korrekt oder lege das Script ab."
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -x "$SCRIPT_PATH" ]; then
  echo "WARN: Script ist nicht ausfuehrbar — chmod +x $SCRIPT_PATH"
fi
echo "Script: $SCRIPT_PATH (OK)"
echo ''

echo '--- Lyrics Files ---'
LYRICS_COUNT=$(find "$LYRICS_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.txt' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
echo "Verzeichnis: $LYRICS_DIR"
echo "Lyrics-Dateien gefunden: $LYRICS_COUNT"
if [ "$LYRICS_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo 'FEHLER: Keine Lyrics-Dateien gefunden'
  exit 1
fi
echo ''

echo '--- Bereits generierte Audios ---'
AUDIO_COUNT=$(find "$LYRICS_DIR" -maxdepth 1 \( -name '*.mp3' -o -name '*.wav' \) 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
echo "Audio-Dateien vorhanden: $AUDIO_COUNT"
echo "Verbleibend: $((LYRICS_COUNT - AUDIO_COUNT))"
config.label: Pre-Check: CDP, Script & Lyrics

config.command:
set -uo pipefail
BASE_DIR=$(eval echo '{{ base_dir }}')
cd "$BASE_DIR" || { echo "base_dir nicht erreichbar: $BASE_DIR"; exit 1; }
bash '{{ batch_script }}' --session-mode cdp --continue-on-error --skip-existing --delay {{ delay }} --delay-jitter {{ delay_jitter }} --song-timeout {{ song_timeout }} --max-downloads {{ max_downloads }} '{{ lang_pair }}/{{ collection }}/*.txt'
config.label: Suno Batch Generation

config.command:
set -uo pipefail
echo '=== Suno Batch Results ==='
echo ''
BASE_DIR=$(eval echo '{{ base_dir }}')
LYRICS_DIR="$BASE_DIR/{{ lang_pair }}/{{ collection }}"
LYRICS_COUNT=$(find "$LYRICS_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.txt' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
AUDIO_COUNT=$(find "$LYRICS_DIR" -maxdepth 1 \( -name '*.mp3' -o -name '*.wav' \) 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
echo "Total lyrics files: $LYRICS_COUNT"
echo "Total audio files:  $AUDIO_COUNT"
echo "Success rate: $AUDIO_COUNT / $LYRICS_COUNT"
echo ''
echo '--- Missing Songs ---'
for txt in "$LYRICS_DIR"/*.txt; do
  [ -f "$txt" ] || continue
  base=$(basename "$txt" .txt)
  if [ ! -f "$LYRICS_DIR/$base.mp3" ] && [ ! -f "$LYRICS_DIR/$base.wav" ]; then
    echo "  MISSING: $base"
  fi
done
echo ''
echo 'Done.'
config.label: Result Summary
